title: Delhi BJP Mahila Morcha protests outside Congress HQ
seoTitle: Delhi BJP women protest outside Congress HQ

tea.why: Protesters alleged that Congress leaders misbehaved with women police personnel during earlier demonstrations on Tuesday and Wednesday.
tea.want: They demanded a public apology from Congress leader Rahul Gandhi.
tea.changed: Oct 8: Delhi BJP Mahila Morcha members marched toward the Congress headquarters, were stopped by police barricades, staged a sit-in, and subsequently dispersed.

summary: On October 8, 2026, the Delhi unit of the Bharatiya Janata Party's (BJP) Mahila Morcha organised a protest march toward the Congress headquarters, Indira Bhawan, in Delhi. Led by party figures including Yogita Singh and Aarti Mehra, the demonstrators demanded a public apology from Congress leader Rahul Gandhi, alleging that he and other Congress members misbehaved with women police personnel during earlier demonstrations on Tuesday and Wednesday. The marchers raised slogans near the Andhra Bhawan red light and Hindi Bhawan, where police established a heavy human barricade to stop them. Protesters held a sit-in at the location before police warned them and allowed them to leave.
demands: A public apology from Rahul Gandhi
An apology from the Congress party for insulting women police personnel
response: Police formed a heavy human barricade near Hindi Bhawan to forcibly stop the marchers, issued warnings after a sit-in, and allowed them to leave.

updates.text: BJP Mahila Morcha members marched toward the Congress headquarters in Delhi to protest alleged misconduct against women police personnel.
Police halted the protesters near Hindi Bhawan using human barricades, leading to a temporary sit-in before participants dispersed.
